channel.title: Bruno Stefoni's Blog
channel.description: Technical writing on agents, reinforcement learning, and production AI.

item.title: How Multi-Turn Git RL Rollouts Actually Run
item.description: Sandboxes, hidden repo paths, group rewards, and filters: the pipeline behind effective-batch GRPO debugging.

item.title: Effective Batch Is the Real KPI for GRPO Tool-Use Runs
item.description: Mean reward looked fine on every ablation. Zero-advantage rate and effective batch size predicted which run would die.

item.title: What Offline Ablations Reveal About Agentic Tool-Use Rewards
item.description: Offline ablations across 200 git episodes: scoring tool responses erases the GRPO learning signal, and a small write-tool bonus is decisive.

item.title: Teaching a 4B Model to Chain Git Operations Through Pure RL: A Debugging Story
item.description: Training Qwen3-4B to discover multi-turn git tool chains entirely from reward signal: no demonstrations, no SFT. Six reward function versions, four failure modes, and the fix that finally worked.

item.title: Nombre Guaguas: Exploring a Century of Chilean Baby Name Trends
item.description: A fully serverless dashboard that visualizes baby name trends in Chile from 1920 to 2025, with an AI chat assistant for natural language exploration. Built on Cloudflare's edge network with data from Chile's Civil Registry.

item.title: Teaching an LLM to Use Git Through Pure Reinforcement Learning
item.description: We built an agentic RL environment, watched rewards immediately saturate at 0.96, realized our reward function was lying, fixed it, trained for 200 steps, and got a W-shaped reward curve with a 20-step catastrophic collapse in the middle.
